items.label: MA-SEC administrative: Fidelity Brokerage Services LLC
items.detail: Securities Division consent order (Docket E-2024-0373) over failure to enforce access controls that exposed customer documents in an August 2024 data breach; date is the order date listed on the Division enforcement page. Administrative fine of $1250000 to the Commonwealth; respondent neither admits nor denies the facts or violations; read from the order PDF text.
